en.title: Make Grid Symmetric
en.description:
In each operation, you may flip the color of one cell. Find the minimum number of flips so that every row and every column is symmetric about its own center.

This site's standard input/output format and any supplementary ranges follow this problem's description.
en.input: The first line contains n m (1≤n,m≤200), followed by n strings of length m containing only B/W. The upper bounds on n and m are site supplements; the original problem gives none.
en.output: Output the minimum number of cells to flip.
en.explanation: Group the cells that constrain each other under vertical and horizontal mirroring into orbits of at most four cells; make each group uniform with its majority color.
